references.text: Cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop are also mentioned in the instructions for cleansing leprosy as part of the same ritual.
The same ritual with two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop is used for cleansing a house afflicted with leprosy.
Cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet yarn are also used in the ritual involving the red heifer for purification from impurity.
Living water (running water) is used in the cleansing ritual with the ashes of the red heifer, just as it is used here.
Hyssop was used to apply blood on the doorposts during Passover, a similar use of hyssop in connection with blood and purification.
David asks to be cleansed with hyssop, alluding to the cleansing rituals in the Mosaic Law.
The Letter to the Hebrews refers to the use of scarlet wool and hyssop together with blood in the covenant ceremony, linking these to such purification rituals.
At the crucifixion, a sponge soaked in vinegar was placed on a stalk of hyssop and given to Jesus, which can be seen as an allusion to cleansing rituals.
